art_direction: 浅燕麦底，双眼稍稍睁开向上看，温柔而安静地期待。
composition_variation: Keep the pair near level with the right eye wider. Open both a little beyond a sleepy gaze while retaining relaxed lids, and place the large pupils slightly upward. Use broad curved lower edges and matching side bands. Convey gentle hopeful attention with no decorative sparkles or marks. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
